Fabee is an AI nutrition coach for iPhone that you use by chatting. You type or dictate what you ate, and it logs the calories, protein, carbs and fat of each food on a card. Fabee splits a dish into its parts and counts each one, so your own recipes and restaurant meals work too. What if it gets something wrong? Say so. “It was two eggs, not three” and the card updates. You can also tap any amount and change it. Where does my data go? Your food log and photos stay on your iPhone. If you turn on sync, a copy is saved to your Fabee account on our servers in the EU, so a new iPhone gets it back. items.descZh: Fabee是一款针对iPhone的AI营养教练应用，旨在通过聊天交互帮助用户轻松跟踪饮食并获取个性化建议。其核心功能允许用户通过文本输入或拍照记录食物，自动计算卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪等宏量营养素，并提供每日和每周的进展分析。亮点包括具体性能数字，如示例中早餐记录为273kcal含18g蛋白质，午餐458kcal含43g蛋白质，应用能记住用户偏好如过敏原，并智能调整建议。适用场景涵盖家庭烹饪和外出就餐，适合希望简化饮食管理、控制体重或优化营养摄入的用户。

files navigation goatedcontext [](https://github.com/razzyshmazzy/goatedcontext/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://github.com/razzyshmazzy/goatedcontext/stargazers) goatedcontext gives coding agents persistent developer context. You tell an agent how you work once; it saves that locally; future sessions and other agents retrieve it, so you stop repeating yourself. Agents can read and save context on their own, and you keep full control over everything stored. It works in Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor out of the box, and with any agent that can speak MCP, invoke a subprocess, or read AGENTS.md. Without goatedcontext: New session. Nothing remembers the last one. You: Add zod. Agent: npm install zod Wrong manager. You moved this repo to pnpm last week, but that was a different session and the agent never saw it. With goatedcontext: You: Add zod. Agent: pnpm add zod You said "for this repo, use pnpm" once, days ago. goatedcontext saved it and handed it back when it mattered. You didn't repeat yourself, and you didn't run any commands to make this happen. On a heldout benchmark of 320 real Claude Code trials, goatedcontext raised freshsession preference adherence from 24% to 54% ([report](/razzyshmazzy/goatedcontext/blob/main/benchmarks/results/heldoutv1%5F1sonnet46/REPORT.md)). goatedcontext is not a contextwindow extension, a transcript RAG system, or a vector database. It stores structured developer context in a local SQLite file and gives the relevant slice to supported agents. That's the whole idea. What it saves Three kinds of memory, kept deliberately separate: 1. Preferences: durable rules you set, like "use pnpm here" or "prefer strict TypeScript." These are what actually steer the agent. 2. Signals: oneoff decisions worth noting, like "this project used Supabase." Evidence, never promoted to a rule on its own. 3. Proposals: things the agent suspects are preferences but isn't sure about. They steer nothing until you approve them. Details and precedence rules are in [The memory model](thememorymodel). Installation npx goatedcontext setup Node 22.13+. setup installs the persistent ctx CLI, detects which agents you have, and wires up their integrations. Rerun it anytime to upgrade or repair. You never npm install g by hand. Check it worked: ctx agents which agents are detected and wir
items.author: nicozametto
items.descZh: goatedcontext 是一款为 AI 编程 Agent 提供持久化开发上下文的创新工具，旨在解决跨会话和多 Agent 协作中开发指令遗忘的痛点。核心功能上，它通过本地 SQLite 数据库将开发者偏好、一次性技术选型信号以及待确认的 Agent 建议分类结构化存储，使 Agent 能够自主读取和更新上下文。亮点在于，在 320 次真实 Claude Code 试验的留出基准测试中，goatedcontext 成功将新会话的偏好遵循率从 24% 提升至 54%，显著增强了 Agent 的执行准确性。该工具开箱即用支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor，并兼容任何通过 MCP、子进程或 AGENTS.md 交互的 Agent。它非常适合需要跨多个会话和不同 Agent 之间保持技术栈一致性（如强制使用 pnpm 或严格 TypeScript）的复杂软件开发团队。
items.quote: goatedcontext 为编码智能体提供持久的开发者上下文。

AgentGate is an outofprocess authorization proxy and security gateway for autonomous AI agent tool execution. It intercepts tool invocations prior to runtime, evaluates prompt injection and blastradius risks via a sub40ms neural classification head, and enforces deterministic access control policies before actions reach production infrastructure. [](/mohitdebian/AgentGate/blob/main/docs/images/demo.gif) 🎮 Live Interactive Playground: <https://huggingface.co/spaces/codeload/agentgatedemo Quickstart git clone https://github.com/mohitdebian/AgentGate.git cd AgentGate docker compose up d Dashboard → http://localhost:5173 Drop a tool call into the gateway: import requests session = requests.post("http://localhost:8080/v1/sessions", json={ "agent_id": "myagent", "goal": "Run system diagnostics" }).json() result = requests.post("http://localhost:8080/v1/assess", json={ "session_id": session["session_id"], "action": {"tool": "bash_exec", "arguments": {"command": "rm rf /var/www"}} }).json() → {"verdict": "deny", "reason_codes": ["untrusted_prompt_influence"]} For MCP, TypeScript, LangChain, CrewAI, and REST examples → [Client Integration Guide](https://github.com/mohitdebian/AgentGate/wiki/ClientIntegrationGuide) How It Works Autonomous agents lack a hard boundary between developer instructions and untrusted data inside the context window. items.author: 13lack13lood
items.descZh: ColdIVF 是一款基于 Rust 开发的读取优化型向量索引库，专为解决冷读取（cold reads）场景下的高延迟问题而设计。该库支持 128 至 4080 维的向量，同时提供 Python 绑定（基于 maturin 构建）和原生 Rust 接口，方便开发者快速集成。其核心亮点在于通过异步预加载聚类表（如调用 `index.prepare()` 在 embedding 运行时加载表格）来优化冷首查询性能，并支持在后台进行索引紧凑（`begin_compact`）的同时无缝继续查询。此外，它提供了灵活的检索参数配置（如默认 `nprobe=96`、`rerank=35`）以及完整的增删改查与数据同步机制。该方案非常适用于对延迟敏感的语义搜索、推荐系统及 RAG（检索增强生成）场景中的冷启动向量检索。
items.quote: 一个用 Rust 构建的、面向读取优化的向量索引，专为冷读取场景设计。

[](/smashah/brutus/blob/main/assets/readme/brutus.png) [Installation](installation) · [Download the release](https://github.com/smashah/brutus/releases/latest) · [How it works](/smashah/brutus/blob/main/docs/howitworks.md) · [Agent skill](/smashah/brutus/blob/main/skills/brutus/SKILL.md) I’m still using a MacBook I bought several years ago, and I want to squeeze every last drop of productivity out of it. With agents working in parallel, that increasingly means keeping a small army of subprocesses from overwhelming the machine. Each harness can spawn agents, tool calls, build processes, dev servers, and browser helpers. When resource usage goes insane, it’s hard to work out which subprocess belongs to which job. The usual response is to find the biggest number in Activity Monitor or Stats and kill the whole parent process, which interrupts other jobs and leaves you starting them back up. I wanted a smaller intervention: find the individual subprocess that’s seizing the Mac and stop that one. Where an agent or harness can retry the failed work, it can handle that recovery while the other jobs have a chance to carry on. Brutus targets the PID you choose; the surrounding agent or app handles what happens next. Brutus samples resource usage for about three seconds and offers the top three individual processes, with their launch commands, memory, CPU use, and Swap in rate. Under memory pressure, active swap readbacks and growing memory use influence the ranking. RAM, swap, SSD space left, and active memory transfers stay visible. Press I for the full command, working folder, and compressedmemory details to help recognize the job before stopping it. Why “Brutus”? A process that’s seizing your Mac is a seizer, which sounds suspiciously like Caesar. Hence Brutus: one small, surgical intervention aimed at freeing up the machine while sparing the rest of the workload. The goal is to get more useful work out of the Mac I already have, with fewer interruptions to the agents working on it. Installation macOS only. The release binary contains Apple silicon and Intel slices and targets macOS 12 or newer. Runtime measurements were taken on Apple silicon; an Intel machine has not been exercised yet. Install and make brutus available immediately: curl fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smashah/brutus/main/install.sh sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" Run brutus dryrun to try every menu action without closing anything, or brutus to choose a process to close. Set BRUTUS_INSTALL_DIR to choose another directory and use that directory in the export too. Prefer Homebrew? brew tap smashah/brutus https://github.com/smashah/brutus brew install smashah/brutus/brutus Homebrew may ask you to trust the formula. The binary is adhoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. You can also [build from source](buildfromsource). Choose, inspect, close Key Action ↑ / ↓ Choose an individual process Enter Close the selected process; preview it in \dryrun I Show its full command, resource samples, paths, and system details R Take a new sample in the same screen M More commands, including closing all shown processes Q Quit without closing anything In the info view, arrows scroll and I or Esc returns to the list. items.descZh: 随着Mac上并行AI代理和开发工具链的普及，子进程资源过载难以精准定位成为开发者的核心痛点。Brutus是一款专为macOS 12及以上版本设计的轻量级原生命令行工具，旨在通过“外科手术式”的精准干预替代传统的粗暴杀进程方式。它通过约三秒的资源采样，智能筛选出内存、CPU和Swap占用最高的三个子进程，并提供完整的启动命令、工作路径和系统资源实时状态。该工具特别适用于多代理并行和复杂开发工作流，允许用户单独关闭特定异常进程，而由父应用负责后续恢复，从而避免了整个工作流的中断。通过最小化的干预实现最大化的硬件性能释放，特别适合老旧Mac设备的生产力抢救。
items.quote: Brutus 以您选择的 PID 为目标；周围的代理或应用程序处理接下来发生的事情。
